description: Top up the agent wallet with crypto (pass the ak_live_ api key from create_wallet). Returns a crypto payment address and amount; the balance is credited automatically once the payment confirms on-chain. Minimum $100.

api_key.description: The ak_live_ key returned by create_wallet. Pass it here, or as an Authorization: Bearer header.

coin.description: Payment method id, e.g. usdttrc20 (default), btc, eth, trx. See payment options on buyukesim.com.

name: create_deposit
